from pathlib import Path

 data=f.read_bytes(); pos=0; chunks=[]
 ok=True
 while pos+8<=len(data):
  mt=data[pos:pos+3].decode('latin1'); ct=chr(data[pos+3]); sz=struct.unpack_from('<I',data,pos+4)[0]

  chunks.append((pos,mt,ct,sz,'')); pos+=sz
 if pos!=len(data): ok=False
 print(f.name, len(data), ok, [(c[1],c[2],c[3]) for c in chunks[:20]])
